title_zh: 为父母周年聚餐确认人数

scenario.label_zh: 安排父母结婚周年聚餐
scenario.goal_zh: 确定参加人数并为家庭纪念日协调见面时间。

context_zh: 兄妹预订父母结婚周年聚餐，核对参加人数和到场时间。
author: author-phase03-b

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: Shall we celebrate Mum and Dad's anniversary at the little restaurant by the station?

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: Brilliant. They went there when they were a young couple.

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: Exactly. It will be the two of them, the two of us, and Grandma. Five people.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: I can bring Grandma. Would six thirty be too early?

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: That works. I will book a table for five at six thirty.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: Great. I will collect Grandma at six and meet you at the restaurant.
